notes.title: New episode alert! Mexico levels are available! Play free! April 13, 2023 update
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that we have added a brand new location to our game - Mexico! Immerse yourself in the vibrant culture of Mexico with four new exciting locations to explore.
Visit the Old Cemetery during the Day of the Dead, where you can experience the colorful and festive celebration of this beloved holiday. Take a trip to Copper Canyon and marvel at the breathtaking views of this natural wonder.
Explore Mexico City, one of the largest and most dynamic cities in the world, and discover its rich history and vibrant energy. And finally, journey to the ancient Mayan pyramids and unlock the mysteries of this fascinating civilization.

Update your game and get ready to experience 120 new levels with 32 artifacts to recover!
